85cadf640a1f6b52.description: About the Role Thermo Fisher Scientific is seeking a Clinical Trial Coordinator FSP to join its global team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing administrative and technical support to the Project Team, contributing to clinical trials that have supported top pharmaceutical companies and biotechs across over 100 countries. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 year of experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate, oversee, and complete assigned trial activities as detailed in the task matrix, according to the specific role (Central or Local). Perform department, internal, country, and investigator file reviews, documenting findings in appropriate systems. Ensure allocated tasks are performed on time, within budget, and to a high-quality standard, proactively communicating any risks to project leads. Provide system support (*, Activate & eTMF) and ensure system databases are current. Perform administrative tasks including timely processing of documents, eTMF reviews, distributing communications, and providing documents/reports to internal team members. Analyze and reconcile study metrics and findings reports, assisting with clarification and resolution of site documentation findings. Assist with coordination, compilation, and distribution of Investigator Site File (ISF) and Pharmacy binder materials, and non-clinical study supplies to sites. Support audit readiness by ensuring files are reviewed according to organizational SOPs and department guidance. Provide administrative support for site activation activities and aid in developing the critical path for rapid site activations. Utilize local knowledge and systems to develop and review site lists suitable for feasibility activities and provide input into the site tiering process. Support start-up teams in regulatory submissions and work directly with sites to obtain necessary documents. Act as a buddy during onboarding and provide training to new staff as needed. Qualifications and Experience High / Secondary school diploma or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification. Bachelor's degree is preferred. Previous experience providing the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job, comparable to 0 to 1 year. An equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training, and/or directly related experience, may be considered. Required Skills and Abilities Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Demonstrated ability to analyze project-specific data/systems for accuracy and efficiency. Strong customer focus and flexibility to reprioritize workload. Good working knowledge of applicable Country Regulations, ICH Good Clinical Practices, and relevant SOPs. Proficient English language and grammar skills, with local language skills as needed. Good computer skills, proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and ability to master clinical trial database systems. Self-motivated with a positive attitude and good interpersonal skills. Effective oral and written communication skills. Sound judgment and decision-making skills. Capable of accurately following project work instructions and managing risk appropriately. Work Environment Work is performed in an office, laboratory, clinical, and/or home office environment, involving exposure to electrical office equipment. Occasional drives to site locations and potential occasional travel may be required.

85199fb362a670f5.description: About the Role Red Sea Gateway Terminal is seeking a Mobile Equipment Mechanical Technician to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing hands-on maintenance services for mobile equipment and vehicles, ensuring high standards of work quality and meeting operational priorities. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Execute maintenance and repair activities for mobile equipment and vehicles in accordance with operational and planning indications. Ensure work is performed to the highest standard, consistent with available resources, time, and operational requirements. Identify technical and process problems, advising the line manager accordingly, and ensuring effective communication regarding equipment repair and maintenance. Identify and report necessary parts and materials to achieve maintenance and repair objectives. Perform all work safely and in compliance with department, company, and port rules and regulations. Maintain tidy and clean working areas, tools, and working gear. Ensure full and complete maintenance and repair records are maintained to facilitate planning and analysis. Report to duty hours on time and in compliance with HR Policy. Follow safety rules, procedures, work instructions, and coexistence rules. Performance Indicators Equipment Performance (MTBF TT, RS & EH) PM schedule per month compliance Quality Score and Rework Safety LTIR 5S Daily Practice Monthly reporting to duty hours Behavior notices and warning letters Work Environment This role involves field-based work, often under hot weather conditions. Exposure to contaminants such as degreasers, oil, and grease is expected. There may also be occasional exposure to areas with noise and inadequate lighting. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage is always required while in the field.

8568f6e1b85c571b.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Low Current Engineer (Audio Video & Lighting Show Content) to join their team in Makkah. This full-time role involves overseeing the technical delivery of low-current Audio, Video, Lighting (AVL) and show-content systems. The engineer will manage projects from design review and multidisciplinary coordination through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover, ensuring systems meet approved specifications, performance, safety, and visitor experience requirements. Key Responsibilities Review specifications, drawings, calculations, equipment schedules, and system architectures for audio, video, lighting, show control, and associated low-current networks. Identify gaps, interface risks, and constructability issues, and review shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, inspection and test plans, and technical queries. Coordinate audio systems including loudspeakers, amplifiers, digital signal processing, microphones, and networked audio, verifying coverage, zoning, intelligibility, and integration. Oversee video systems such as projection, LED displays, video processing, switching, media servers, and signal distribution, coordinating resolution, playback, synchronization, alignment, and calibration. Coordinate show-lighting fixtures, control consoles, dimming, lighting networks, and control protocols (*, DMX), verifying addressing, patching, scene operation, and electrical interfaces. Review control narratives, signal flow, cue lists, timecode, synchronization, and interfaces between various systems, ensuring reliable startup, shutdown, and fault-recovery. Translate creative and operational requirements into technical content-delivery specifications, coordinating media formats, codecs, resolutions, frame rates, and playback mapping with content producers and system integrators. Verify approved show assets are correctly ingested, mapped, synchronized, and played on installed systems, and resolve playback, timing, image, and audio issues during integrated rehearsals. Coordinate with various teams (architecture, ICT, electrical, mechanical, etc.) on equipment space, containment, power, cooling, access, mounting, and maintenance. Monitor installation quality, inspect cabling, labeling, terminations, equipment racks, mounting, grounding, and access provisions, recording defects and tracking corrective actions. Coordinate contractors, suppliers, integrators, and content vendors, monitoring technical progress, dependencies, procurement risks, and site readiness. Review and witness factory and site acceptance tests, subsystem testing, and integrated performance tests, verifying acceptance criteria and tracking punch-list closure. Review as-built drawings, configuration backups, software and license records, warranties, operation and maintenance manuals, and training materials, confirming operator training and maintainability. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong troubleshooting capabilities. Demonstrated experience in interface management and stakeholder coordination. Proficiency in technical reporting. Ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, creative teams, contractors, and operators. Proven ability to coordinate technical submissions, ensure installation meets approved requirements, and achieve synchronized show playback and reliable integrated operation. Experience in timely closure of defects and delivery of complete, usable handover documentation with trained operators. Desired Skills Familiarity with applicable Saudi requirements and professional registration obligations is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah.

85aa166b070411de.description: About Accor Accor fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing each team member's contribution. The company is committed to business ethics, responsible tourism, sustainable development, community outreach, and diversity and inclusion. With a portfolio of hotels and brands, Accor offers opportunities for career advancement and professional development globally. The Role of Finance Manager Accor is seeking a Finance Manager for a full-time position in Al Madinah, with locations including Yanbu and Medina. This senior role offers scope for impact and growth. The Finance Manager will ensure timely and accurate financial management reports, adhering to country tax regulations, corporate office requirements, and owner specifications. The role involves establishing proper internal controls and leading the development of accounting staff through training and cross-training to meet the hotel’s people and culture needs. Candidates should have 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Ensure all accounting colleagues understand and adhere to company accounting policies and procedures, especially those related to country tax rules and regulations. Monitor daily routines within the accounting department to ensure effective, efficient, and tax-compliant work practices. Supervise and assist with account reconciliations, account analysis, and month-end closing procedures. Verify the accuracy of night audit transactions in terms of applicable tax rules and monitor adherence to established procedures for all hotel department purchases or sales. Oversee the filing and maintenance of all tax accounting-related documents and records in accordance with country document retention regulations and the Hotel Management Agreement. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of all operational financial reporting to both FRHI and the Owner. Plan, educate, and audit departmental and hotel staff involved in ordering goods or signing tax-related documents. Oversee training, cross-training, and development of hotel staff on local taxation issues. Perform related tasks such as leading forecasting, reporting, budgeting, internal control, and completing account analysis. Prepare all financial statements, accruals, and journal entries, and maintain reconciliations for all balance sheet accounts related to taxation, in established corporate formats and according to generally accepted accounting principles. Supervise and ensure all reports and documents comply with IFRS, the latest edition of the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry, and Hotel Management Agreement requirements. Maintain thorough knowledge of all tax-related documents and laws in the country and follow up on all changes. Lead the preparation of all budgets and forecasts. Supervise the day-to-day activities of Accounting staff, providing assistance as needed. Prepare or oversee the preparation of all local, state, and other tax filings, returns, and reporting on a timely basis, to the extent of the operating company’s responsibility. Participate in and develop staff training programs to minimize colleague turnover and ensure effective accounting office operations. Conduct oneself professionally at all times to reflect brand standards and encourage staff to do the same. Required Qualifications Thorough knowledge of all jobs within the Accounting areas. Commitment to following all local and corporate policies and procedures. High degree of professional integrity and confidentiality. Ability to work in a safe, prudent, and organized manner.

85e2bd9b33938c0d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الهضبة للتعليم عن أخصائي تنظيم إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دراسة وتحليل التجارب والممارسات الدولية في مجال التنظيم الإداري، وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية، واقتراح الخطط والبرامج اللازمة لتحسين الهياكل التنظيمية وإجراءات العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة التجارب والممارسات الدولية المتخصصة في التنظيم الإداري، وتقييم إمكانية وجدوى تطبيقها. تقديم التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات الحديثة في مجال التنظيم الإداري. تحليل الأوضاع الإدارية الحالية وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية للجهة المعنية. اقتراح الخطط والبرامج الضرورية لعمليات التطوير وإعداد الأدلة التنظيمية وأدلة إجراءات العمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة المستجدات في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتنظيم الإداري، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض التقارير والوثائق على المعنيين ومناقشتها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التنظيم الإداري أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل التجارب والممارسات الدولية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. القدرة على اقتراح الخطط والبرامج التطويرية. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

85c5e2ea132c145c.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Engineer - Civil & Structures to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves designing, analyzing, and overseeing the construction of structural systems for various projects. The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure all structures meet safety standards, building codes, and project specifications. Role Overview The Engineer - Civil & Structures will contribute to delivering high-quality engineering solutions by applying strong technical expertise and organized project management capabilities. This role is central to ensuring structural integrity and compliance throughout the project lifecycle, from initial design to construction oversight. Key Responsibilities Design and analyze structural systems using advanced CAD and structural analysis software, ensuring compliance with Saudi Arabian building codes and international standards. Conduct detailed structural calculations and prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including design drawings, specifications, and engineering reports. Perform site inspections and supervise construction activities to verify that work is executed according to design specifications and quality standards. Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other engineering disciplines to resolve design challenges and optimize structural solutions. Evaluate material properties, construction methods, and geotechnical conditions to inform design decisions and mitigate risks. Prepare and review construction documents, including bills of quantities, schedules, and technical specifications. Analyze project requirements and develop efficient, cost-effective structural solutions that meet client objectives. Maintain organized project files, documentation, and records for all phases of design and construction. Communicate technical information clearly to stakeholders, including clients, contractors, and team members. Stay current with industry standards, building codes, and emerging technologies in civil and structural engineering. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in civil and structural engineering. Demonstrated expertise in structural design, analysis, and construction oversight. Proficiency in CAD and structural analysis software. Strong understanding of Saudi Arabian building codes and international standards. Required Skills Strong technical expertise in civil and structural engineering. Organized project management capabilities. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communication skills for technical information. Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to diverse projects within a collaborative engineering environment.

85e60a92947787a8.description: About the Role The Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu is seeking an Interventional Cardiology Consultant to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time role focuses on advanced skills in Interventional Cardiology, with a primary emphasis on Percutaneous Coronary Intervention, and aims to enhance the efficiency of the daily Cardiac Catheter Lab workflow. Key Responsibilities Deliver clinical services as delegated by the Cardiology section head. Perform diagnostic and interventional angiography procedures in accordance with approved clinical privileges. Coordinate patient admissions and discharges to optimize Cardiac Catheter Laboratory operating sessions and maximize bed occupancy in the cardiac unit. Adhere to the Medical Staff Bylaws, Code of Medical Ethics, and all relevant rules and regulations specific to the department and hospital. Contribute to the efficient flow of workload and clinical service within the Cardiac Catheter Lab, ensuring lists are completed with a high standard of clinical practice. Ensure a safe work environment and practices, minimizing risks to self, staff, and patients. Maintain or exceed standards for infection control, clinical risk management, and legislative compliance. Take immediate action to rectify unsafe situations or acts, reporting all incidents and near misses according to hospital policy. Provide the highest attainable standard of medical care for assigned patients. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities, within the hospital or affiliated medical facilities. Qualifications and Experience Graduate of an accredited medical school. Completion of appropriate internship requirements. Possession of a Saudi Board certification or an equivalent qualification such as American Board, Canadian Board, Australian, CCST or CCT for Europe, or other degrees that qualify for consultant grade after the required years of experience. The duration of training for these qualifications must be not less than three years. Equivalent completion of Advanced Training in Interventional Cardiology. Certified or certifiable by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties. A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required. Work Environment This role is based in Al Jubail and involves working within a dedicated Cardiac Catheter Lab, contributing to a team focused on delivering high standards of cardiac care. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8516021f36d52147.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a JIB Crane Operator to join our team. This full-time position involves the safe and efficient operation of various types and sizes of Jib Cranes, adhering strictly to given instructions and safety requirements. The role requires 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily visual inspections of the crane before use and report any identified issues. Perform precise lifting, lowering, and maneuvering of materials within the workshop(s). Follow instructions from L&R signalmen, foremen, and supervisors in accordance with L&R operation and safety procedures. Operate the crane within its designed Safe Working Load (SWL), following the operation manual, load charts, and supervisor instructions, while being aware of crane limits in terms of reach and capacity. Complete the daily operations crane checklist before commencing any operation. Assume full responsibility for all safety and quality aspects related to crane setup, load rigging, lifts, movements, dismantling, and relocation. Oversee crane maintenance, load, and functional tests. Perform front-end (operator-driven) maintenance as required. Ensure proper licensing and inspections are current and coordinate necessary maintenance and repairs with the L&R supervisor, TS inspection division, and Maintenance team. Stop unsafe activities and report potential hazards to the L&R foreman, supervisor, and safety team. Perform physical activities and assist in workshop rigging and fabrication activities. Provide input for daily work sheets and crane time sheets for each project. Ensure all required documents and permits are available before executing operations. Work effectively in a standard field environment, maintaining awareness of surroundings and ongoing operations, including forklift and manlift sizes and required movement areas. Assist in training local workforce as required and share knowledge with the team. Complete daily pre-use check sheets and record all faults found. Assist riggers and other functions as required or directed by the supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in operating Jib Cranes. Demonstrated ability to operate various types and sizes of Jib Cranes safely and efficiently. Understanding of crane operation manuals, load charts, and safety procedures. Ability to follow instructions from signalmen, foremen, and supervisors. Required Skills Strong commitment to safety protocols and quality standards. Attention to detail for daily inspections and checklist completion. Effective communication skills to report issues and follow instructions. Ability to perform physical activities and assist in rigging and fabrication. Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to train and share knowledge. Work Environment This role operates within a standard field environment, requiring constant awareness of surroundings and ongoing operations, including the movement of heavy machinery like forklifts and manlifts. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

851a08215a423005.description: About the Role United Motors Group is seeking a Parts Sales Consultant to join its aftersales division. This full-time role involves assisting customers with vehicle parts identification and purchase, ensuring inventory accuracy, and contributing to the division's overall success. Key Responsibilities Assist customers in identifying parts needs, providing accurate information, and recommending suitable parts based on vehicle specifications. Demonstrate product knowledge, explaining features, benefits, and compatibility of various parts. Process parts orders, including pricing, invoicing, and arranging for delivery or pickup. Upsell and cross-sell related parts and accessories to maximize sales opportunities. Maintain accurate inventory records, including stock levels, part numbers, and pricing. Monitor inventory levels and place orders with suppliers to ensure adequate stock. Receive and inspect incoming parts shipments, verifying accuracy and quality. Organize and maintain the parts storage area, ensuring cleanliness and proper organization. Provide technical support to customers, assisting with part identification, installation instructions, and troubleshooting. Collaborate with technicians and service advisors to address customer inquiries and resolve technical issues. Stay updated with product knowledge, technical specifications, and industry trends related to automotive parts. Build and maintain strong customer relationships, ensuring satisfaction and loyalty. Follow up with customers to ensure parts needs are met and address any concerns. Collaborate with the sales team and service department to enhance the overall customer experience. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engine and Vehicle, or a related field. 1-3 years of relevant work experience in parts sales. Work Type This is a full-time position within United Motors Group.

8561863f620d74a2.description: About Accor and Sofitel Riyadh Accor is a global leader in hospitality, offering a diverse portfolio of brands. The Sofitel Riyadh Hotel & Convention Center provides a five-star experience characterized by luxury, elegance, and service. The hotel focuses on personalized attention to ensure a memorable stay, blending urban sophistication with refined opulence in Riyadh. The Role of Director of Engineering As the Director of Engineering at Sofitel Riyadh, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing all engineering and maintenance operations. This full-time role involves ensuring high standards of safety, efficiency, and operational excellence across the hotel facilities. You will implement preventive maintenance programs, maintain the reliability of hotel equipment, and ensure a safe and comfortable environment for guests and staff. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the Engineering Department, ensuring efficient daily operations and compliance with hotel standards. Develop, implement, and monitor comprehensive preventive maintenance programs for all hotel areas and technical systems. Oversee the operation, maintenance, and reliability of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems. Ensure prompt responses to maintenance requests from guests, staff, and management. Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental operating budget, focusing on cost control and resource utilization. Monitor energy and water consumption, implementing initiatives for efficiency and sustainability. Ensure full compliance with building codes, fire and life safety regulations, and occupational health and safety standards. Lead emergency preparedness and response activities. Manage engineering service contracts, external contractors, and suppliers. Oversee recruitment, scheduling, performance management, training, and development of engineering staff. Conduct regular inspections to identify maintenance needs and operational risks. Coordinate engineering-related inspections, audits, and risk management requirements. Collaborate with other departments to support seamless hotel operations. Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement. Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment documentation, and compliance reports. Participate in hotel management meetings and operational committees. Remain available to respond to operational emergencies and critical maintenance situations. Qualifications and Requirements Proven leadership experience (2-5 years) in engineering or facilities management within luxury hotels, resorts, or large-scale hospitality environments. Strong technical expertise in engineering operations, facilities management, preventive maintenance, and asset lifecycle planning. Demonstrated experience managing engineering operations in an established luxury hotel, ensuring business continuity and asset reliability. Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, CAPEX planning, project execution, and contract management. Comprehensive knowledge of building codes, fire and life safety regulations, and local regulatory requirements, including the Saudi Building Code and Civil Defense standards. Proven experience in emergency preparedness, risk management, and maintaining fire and life safety systems. Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop and motivate high-performing teams. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration. Highly organized, results-driven, proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS). Strong commitment to sustainability, energy efficiency, and operational excellence. Hands-on leadership approach, fostering a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Experience overseeing engineering operations in large-scale hotels with extensive meeting, conference, and convention facilities is highly desirable. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where you will lead the Engineering team within a luxury hotel and convention center setting. The role requires collaboration with various hotel departments to ensure seamless operations and exceptional guest experiences. Application Process Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary information will be disclosed during the application process.

858eb304d9614f6d.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Program Manager – Technical Delivery to lead program-level technical delivery coordination for a nationwide CCTV deployment program in Riyadh. This full-time role encompasses planning, mobilization, implementation, and operational readiness, requiring over 10 years of experience. The Program Manager will coordinate technical delivery, regulatory and operational framework development, service bundle definition, technical laboratory establishment, and procurement activities within the agreed PMO assignment. Key Responsibilities Lead program-level planning, mobilization, and delivery coordination for the nationwide CCTV deployment program within the PMO scope. Develop and maintain the technical workstream delivery plan, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, costs, and benefits. Coordinate technical workstreams covering CCTV infrastructure, command-and-control platforms, connectivity, data storage, monitoring, analytics, cybersecurity, and systems integration. Define deployment models, implementation phases, site prioritization criteria, rollout sequencing, and readiness requirements. Coordinate and monitor plans, interfaces, approvals, and readiness evidence from client-appointed delivery entities. Ensure alignment between technology deployment, operational processes, service requirements, and regulatory obligations. Monitor implementation progress and take corrective action for schedule, cost, quality, resource, or technical risks. Coordinate delivery activities across internal teams, contractors, technology suppliers, government entities, and external partners. Coordinate confirmation of technical standards, acceptance criteria, quality controls, and documentation requirements. Lead program-level transition planning and readiness reviews for business-as-usual operations. Regulatory and Operational Framework Development Coordinate the development of regulatory compliance and operational frameworks for the CCTV program. Define policies, procedures, standards, controls, roles, responsibilities, and approval mechanisms for CCTV deployment and operation. Ensure program activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, privacy requirements, data protection principles, cybersecurity standards, and government policies. Develop operating models covering surveillance operations, monitoring, incident management, access controls, data retention, evidence handling, system maintenance, and service support. Coordinate with legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, data protection, law enforcement, and operational stakeholders. Technical Laboratory Establishment and Procurement Lead planning and coordination for establishing the client’s technical laboratory as an innovation, testing, demonstration, and operational readiness environment. Define the Lab’s purpose, scope, capabilities, governance model, operating procedures, and success measures. Coordinate and monitor program plans for the design, procurement, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of Lab facilities and technology. Coordinate the development and specialist review of technical requirements, statements of work, specifications, evaluation criteria, service levels, and acceptance criteria. Support market sounding, supplier briefings, requests for information, requests for proposals, tenders, and competitive dialogue activities. Engage with technology vendors, system integrators, telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, consultants, and specialist service providers. Program Governance and Stakeholder Leadership Apply the program governance, controls, reporting, and escalation framework established by the PMO Governance and Controls, leading technical assurance and operational readiness. Prepare technical delivery inputs for program board papers, steering committee materials, executive reports, and dashboards. Monitor program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, issues, dependencies, benefits, and operational readiness. Lead technical and operational readiness reviews, providing evidence and recommendations for program stage gates and assurance reviews. Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, regulators, internal business units, suppliers, technology partners, and operational teams. Lead cross-functional workshops and facilitate alignment between technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, and procurement stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10+ years of experience in program management, particularly in technical delivery roles. Demonstrated experience in leading large-scale technology deployment programs, preferably within CCTV or similar infrastructure projects. Strong understanding of regulatory compliance, operational frameworks, and procurement processes. Ability to manage complex program-level issues and communicate technical information clearly to diverse audiences.

85c4d90136a7a74f.description: About ASMO ASMO is a joint venture between DHL and Aramco, combining DHL’s logistics expertise with Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem. The company aims to redefine procurement and supply chain standards. ASMO is scheduled to be operational in 2025, providing integrated end-to-end procurement and supply chain services for companies across the industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors. Initially, the focus will be on Saudi Aramco and its affiliates, with long-term plans to serve all industrial sectors within Saudi Arabia and eventually the MENA region. Role Overview The Inventory Supervisor at SPARK is responsible for ensuring the safe, accurate, and controlled execution of all inventory management activities. This full-time role involves overseeing inventory control, cycle counting, stock reconciliation, system exception management, stock status management, inventory adjustments, reporting, and implementing process improvements. The supervisor translates site inventory plans and contractual agreements into daily operations by coordinating inventory personnel, operational interfaces, and BY-WMS activities. This is a hands-on frontline leadership position requiring strong operational presence, system discipline, and analytical problem-solving skills, with 10+ years of experience required. Key Responsibilities Lead daily inventory activities, including cycle counts, ad-hoc counts, recounts, stock reconciliation, bin verification, location audits, and inventory status reviews. Execute the approved cycle count program, allocating work based on inventory risk, value, movement history, customer priority, and operational requirements. Ensure physical stock, quantity, bin, lot/batch, serial information, unit of measure, ownership, and inventory status align with BY-WMS and approved records. Oversee discrepancy resolution through recounts, transaction tracing, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and approved adjustment workflows. Monitor BY-WMS inventory interfaces, snapshots, and transaction exceptions, coordinating resolution with Operations, IT, and system support teams. Control inventory adjustments, posting and status changes, holds, transfers, SLED, returns, damaged stock, blocked stock, and scrap-related transactions. Coordinate with inbound, outbound, quality, and operations teams to resolve stock exceptions without uncontrolled manual transactions or workarounds. Monitor inventory accuracy, count completion, recount rates, adjustment trends, status integrity, and unresolved or aging variances. Prepare inventory reports, variance analysis, management updates, audit evidence, and clear handovers. Escalate high-value, recurring, aged, or customer-impacting inventory risks to the Operations Manager. Team Leadership and Compliance Lead inventory controllers, cycle counters, inventory analysts, and other assigned employees, allocating work, setting priorities, and verifying completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. Coach the team on count discipline, scanner use, transaction tracing, reconciliation, evidence collection, and escalation. Identify skill gaps and support training, cross-training, and development of inventory key users. Promote accountability, segregation of duties, independent verification, safety awareness, and disciplined action closure. Ensure compliance with approved inventory policies, SOPs, work instructions, count plans, adjustment controls, HSE, and quality requirements. Enforce correct use of BY-WMS reports, handheld scanning, and approved inventory workflows. Prevent unauthorized changes, unsupported manual postings, and uncontrolled workarounds. Maintain controlled count records, reconciliation evidence, exception logs, adjustment support, and audit documentation. Support SIT, UAT, cutover, operational readiness, and stabilization for inventory-related changes. Utilize KPIs, variance trends, and root-cause analysis to recommend practical improvements. Experience and Qualifications At least 10 years of experience in inventory management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage inventory teams. Strong operational presence and system discipline. Analytical problem-solving skills. Proficiency with BY-WMS or similar Warehouse Management Systems. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

85cfa5818ca68d32.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Senior Architect to join our team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time position involves ensuring architectural work aligns with contract documents and procedural manuals. A strong background in hospitality projects, specifically completed 5-star hotels or resorts, is essential for this role. Review CAD drawings, renderings, layouts, study models, construction documents, and color boards from Architectural Designers, ensuring compliance with codes, standards, and client requirements. Provide technical consultations for interdisciplinary analytical studies and analyses. Write construction specifications and prepare detailed requisitions for equipment and materials. Interface with suppliers as needed, reviewing drawings and samples, and performing technical bid analyses. Coordinate work with engineering and construction units at the project site. Review, approve, and issue detailed design and construction drawings and specifications prepared by others. Provide the seal and signature of a professional architect when required by statute or contract. Offer technical guidance to junior Architects and Architectural Designer/Drafters on projects. Stay updated on current technologies through technical subscriptions and conference attendance. Prepare staffing estimates and execution plans. Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in large-scale projects, including overall responsibility for architectural engineering on such projects. Knowledge of precedents in the specialty area and principles of related engineering design methods and systems. Familiarity with international procedures, design guides, automated, and administrative practices. Competence in the application and coordination of 2-D and 3-D Computer Aided Design (CAD) tools on projects.

851629e89fc581f1.description: About the Role Magrabi Health is seeking a qualified Saudi Biomedical Engineer to join their team in Jeddah or Makkah. This full-time role involves working independently to provide essential repairs and preventive maintenance for medical equipment, ensuring high standards of customer satisfaction. Perform repairs, testing, and calibrations on most diagnostic and therapeutic medical equipment, maintaining associated records as per pre-designed plans. Plan all related activities, including inspection, testing, and maintenance, prior to the start of each year. Provide preventive maintenance to medical equipment safely, independently, and promptly, following manufacturer’s instructions. Monitor radiation safety (including laser) and apply relevant policies and necessary measures. Submit monthly indicator reports to the biomedical engineering manager. 8518e0529ef4626e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دبيب للتأجير عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للخريجين الجدد، حيث لا تشترط الخبرة المسبقة. سيساهم المحاسب في دعم العمليات المالية للشركة وضمان دقة السجلات المحاسبية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسجيل القيود اليومية للمبيعات والمشتريات والمصروفات بدقة عالية. مطابقة مبيعات نقاط البيع والمتجر الإلكتروني مع الحسابات البنكية وبوابات الدفع بشكل يومي، واكتشاف أي فروقات. متابعة الذمم المدينة والدائنة ومستحقات الموردين لضمان التسويات في الوقت المحدد. متابعة حركة المخزون وتكلفة البضاعة المباعة، والمشاركة في عمليات الجرد الدورية. المساعدة في إعداد إقرارات ضريبة القيمة المضافة والزكاة، والالتزام بمتطلبات الفوترة الإلكترونية. إعداد التسويات البنكية الشهرية والتقارير المالية والإدارية اللازمة. تحليل الأرقام المالية واقتراح تحسينات لضبط المصروفات ورفع كفاءة العمل المحاسبي. تعلم الأنظمة المحاسبية المستخدمة في الشركة وتطبيقها بدقة وفعالية. المؤهلات والمتطلبات درجة البكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو الرياضيات أو الإحصاء أو المالية. تقدير امتياز في الشهادة الجامعية (مع ضرورة إرفاق السجل الأكاديمي). لا تشترط الخبرة المسبقة (0-1 سنة خبرة). بيئة العمل يتمركز هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة دبيب للتأجير. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للموظفين الجدد النمو والتطور المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والمقابلة الشخصية.

852fb995efdca39b.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع البدري الطبي عن فني تعقيم للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تعقيم الأدوات والمعدات الطبية بكفاءة ودقة عالية، وفقًا للمعايير والإجراءات المعتمدة. يتولى فني التعقيم مسؤولية استلام الأدوات، تحضير مواد التعقيم، تنفيذ عملية التعقيم والتغليف، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد الكشوفات اللازمة لتسجيل الأدوات والمعدات المطلوب تعقيمها. استلام الأدوات وتصنيفها بناءً على مادة الصنع وشروط التعقيم المحددة لكل نوع. تحديد مواد التعقيم المناسبة للأدوات وفقًا للتعليمات، وتجهيزها بالكميات المطلوبة، وتحضير الأدوات لعملية التعقيم. فحص وتشغيل أجهزة التعقيم، وإجراء عملية التعقيم ومراقبتها حسب المدة المحددة وتعليمات المشرف. تغليف المواد المعقمة وتسليم المعدات والأدوات بعد التعقيم، مع الالتزام بالأسس والإجراءات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات التشغيلية. موقع العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مجمع البدري الطبي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

8548cc206c668e47.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث Primark عن مدير عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في المملكة العربية السعودية. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة عالمية في منصب قيادي بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المدير العام مسؤولية الإشراف على العمليات اليومية وإدارة الأداء العام للمتجر. يشمل ذلك قيادة الفريق، وضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية، والحفاظ على معايير الخدمة والجودة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة الحصول على درجة البكالوريوس أو الدبلوم العالي. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة للدور. عن Primark Primark هي شركة رائدة في قطاع التجزئة، وتوفر بيئة عمل ديناميكية تدعم النمو المهني وتطوير المهارات. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق Primark كمدير عام، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

8551c93a321bf7c4.description: About the Role HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This full-time role involves the design, development, and oversight of mechanical systems and components within various construction and infrastructure projects. Effective communication and coordination skills for multidisciplinary collaboration. Problem-solving abilities for troubleshooting mechanical equipment. 855e2edc6f678cf0.description: خصائي تسويق المهام الوظيفية: إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط والحملات التسويقية. إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي وصناعة المحتوى. التنسيق مع المصممين وشركات الدعاية والإعلان. دراسة السوق وتحليل المنافسين واقتراح فرص النمو. المساهمة في تعزيز المبيعات وزيادة الوعي بالعلامة التجارية. متابعة نتائج الحملات التسويقية وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المشاركة في تنظيم المعارض والفعاليات التسويقية. المؤهلات المطلوبة: درجة البكالوريوس في التسويق أو إدارة الأعمال أو أي تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة لا تقل عن سنة في مجال التسويق (ويُفضل في قطاع الأغذية أو التمور). مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والإبداع وإدارة الوقت. إجادة استخدام برامج Microsoft Office، ومعرفة بأدوات التسويق الرقمي ومنصات التواصل الاجتماعي. القدرة على العمل بروح الفريق وتحقيق المستهدفات. مقر العمل: المدينة المنورة

85ada8a5bbc36d73.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة ناصر محمد مبارك القحطاني التجارية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيقوم المحاسب بإدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية، وإعداد التقارير المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. إتقان إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التجارية للمؤسسة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

8516904dc743b8d2.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. نظرة عامة على الدور يتولى فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية مسؤولية تركيب ومراقبة مجموعة متنوعة من الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. كما يقدم الدعم الفني لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في مشاريع البحث والتطوير، مما يضمن سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة اللازمة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين أثناء تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تقديم المساعدة التقنية للمهندسين في أنشطة البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الصيانة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. بيئة العمل تتطلب هذه الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة حائل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات، مع التركيز على الدقة والجودة في تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات كفني أجهزة إلكترونية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

851e6b969a36a8d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المجتهد العربي عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمشاركة في تطوير الإجراءات والبرامج التي تهدف إلى تعظيم جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال خدمة العملاء. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل الوظيفة إلى تحليل أنظمة خدمة العملاء لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. كما يشارك في تحديث أدلة وإجراءات خدمة العملاء لضمان تقديم خدمة فعالة ومهنية تلبي توقعات العملاء وتتجاوزها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة. تطوير برامج ومبادرات لتعزيز جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء لتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات. وضع الخطط اللازمة لمعالجة وسد الثغرات المكتشفة في أنظمة خدمة العملاء. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال خدمة العملاء. فهم عميق لمؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. بيئة العمل هذه وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات رضا العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

8547d6a8c6d97677.description: About Hafawah Hotels & Resort Hafawah Hotels & Resort is seeking a dedicated Housekeeping Manager to join its team in Al Madinah Al Munawwarah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the high standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction expected within the hotel industry. Role Summary The Housekeeping Manager will be responsible for overseeing all daily operations of the Housekeeping Department. This includes ensuring that all guest rooms, corridors, and public areas consistently meet the hotel’s stringent cleanliness and quality standards. The role involves managing the housekeeping team, coordinating with other departments, and implementing continuous improvements to enhance service quality. Key Responsibilities Oversee the daily operations of the Housekeeping Department to ensure efficient workflow. Ensure all guest rooms, corridors, and public areas meet the hotel’s cleanliness and quality standards. Prepare staff schedules, assign daily tasks, and supervise the housekeeping team. Train, coach, and evaluate housekeeping staff to maintain high performance. Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with cleanliness, quality, and brand standards. Coordinate closely with the Front Office, Maintenance, and other operational departments to ensure timely room readiness. Monitor housekeeping inventory and ensure the availability of cleaning supplies and equipment. Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation policies and procedures. Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests and housekeeping-related concerns. Prepare departmental reports, monitor performance indicators, and implement continuous improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Housekeeping Manager or in a similar supervisory role within the hotel industry. Proven experience in managing hotel housekeeping operations. Full-time availability is required for this position. Work Location This position is based in Medina (Al Madinah Al Munawwarah), Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

Diversity is valued as a source of creativity and innovation, fostering a workforce prepared to meet societal demands.

85655d2726db4736.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking an experienced Sales Manager - Diesel Generators to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Riyadh, or Jeddah and requires a professional with a strong background in power solutions. Role Overview The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving sales and business development for diesel generators and power solutions across various key sectors. This role involves strategic planning, customer relationship management, and project oversight to achieve revenue and growth objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets. Drive business development across Oil & Gas, Construction, Industrial, Infrastructure, Data Centers, Rental, and Government sectors. Develop and maintain relationships with key customers, consultants, contractors, and EPC companies. Manage major projects, tenders, commercial negotiations, and key accounts. Provide technical and commercial guidance on diesel generators and power solutions. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities. Coordinate with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure customer satisfaction. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field. 10-12 years of overall experience in diesel generator sales, power generation, or power solutions. Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Saudi Arabia in a Sales Manager or equivalent sales leadership position. Strong technical and commercial knowledge of generator systems, including generator sizing, synchronization, AMF/ATS, and power solutions. Experience with brands such as Cummins, Perkins, FG Wilson, Mitsubishi, MTU, Volvo Penta, Kohler, AKSA, Caterpillar, or similar brands is preferred. Proven track record in business development, team management, key account management, and achieving sales targets. Excellent communication, negotiation, and client relationship management skills. A Saudi driving license is preferred. Compensation The salary for this position is SAR 13,000-14,000 per month, offered as an all-inclusive package. Location This role is based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, with primary locations in Dammam, Riyadh, or Jeddah.

85843af0cc09683b.description: About Sephora and the Role Sephora is seeking a Store & Workplace Support Tech Lead to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to ensuring stable, secure, and high-performing store technology operations across the region. The successful candidate will have over 10 years of experience in IT support or store technology, preferably within a retail or multi-site environment. Role Overview The Store & Workplace Support Tech Lead is responsible for providing remote and in-field technology support for Sephora stores. This includes expertise in store infrastructure, network connectivity, POS hardware, payment terminals, back-office equipment, and store-specific applications. The role supports store openings, renovations, hardware refreshes, incident resolution, preventive maintenance, asset tracking, vendor coordination, and business continuity activities. The Tech Lead will collaborate with local IT teams in KSA and Dubai, external vendors, EME infrastructure teams, and retail stakeholders in KSA. Key Responsibilities Provide technology leadership, building and coaching the KSA team, and setting key objectives for stores and workplace technology. Manage local tech requirements and plan deployments with the team, aligning KSA team strategies with ME Tech management goals. Ensure knowledge transfer across workplace and store technologies, holding regular checkpoints and team meetings. Manage relationships with external vendors, including hardware expense management, negotiations, and stock management for business continuity. Oversee relationship management with EME and LVMH teams regarding EUX topics. Adhere to relevant IT policies, processes, and standard operating procedures in line with LVMH group and Sephora global rules. Set up dashboards, metrics, and measure the Quality of Service (QoS) of external partners, following up on SLA/SLO and applying penalties as needed. Provide remote and in-field support for store operations, back-office users, POS areas, and Apple/Microsoft devices, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Support retail store technology, including POS terminals, payment devices, network infrastructure, and digital in-store tools. Coordinate with technical services, network, security, application, and vendor teams to troubleshoot connectivity, POS availability, and critical outages. Support store opening, closure, relocation, and renovation activities, ensuring infrastructure readiness and device testing. Perform on-site validation of store technology environments to ensure adherence to Sephora and LVMH standards. Administer and maintain IT assets, including routine maintenance, performance monitoring, and configuration of hardware and software. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of proven experience in IT support or store technology operations, preferably within a retail, hospitality, or multi-site environment. Strong understanding of retail store operations, POS environments, store networks, infrastructure dependencies, and the impact of technology availability on client experience and business continuity. Solid knowledge of store infrastructure, LAN/WAN connectivity, switching, wireless networks, structured cabling, network troubleshooting, O365, Microsoft endpoint environments, basic security controls, and ITIL practices. Ability to analyze, synthesize information, and adapt to change. Effective communication skills for various stakeholders at the EME level, including IT and business. Strong knowledge of procurement and purchasing processes in the ME region, with logistics (export & import processes) being an advantage. Required Skills and Attributes Self-starter with the ability to drive topics to deliver business value. Capable of acting as a reliable IT business partner, focusing on end-user satisfaction. "Hands-on" approach with the ability to operationally contribute to project success. Problem-solving oriented mindset. "End-users" and "service quality" oriented. Comfortable working within a matrix organization. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with local IT teams, external vendors, and regional stakeholders to maintain high standards of technology support across Sephora's retail network.

85ebb2dfda28df4d.job_title: Assistant Manager Cost Controller (F&B and Hospitality)
85ebb2dfda28df4d.description: About Plaza Premium Group Plaza Premium Group, established in Hong Kong in 1998, is a leader in global airport hospitality, operating in over 200 locations across more than 60 international airports. The company focuses on "Making Travel Better" and spans four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and airport dining concepts. In addition to its own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates globally, and has developed Smart Traveler, a mobile-app rewards program. The Role: Assistant Manager Cost Controller (F&B and Hospitality) Plaza Premium Group is seeking an Assistant Manager Cost Controller specializing in F&B and Hospitality to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience to manage and analyze F&B costs, ensuring financial accuracy and operational efficiency within the hospitality sector. Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze weekly and monthly F&B costs, including consumptions, purchase price variances, and other key cost indicators. Prepare F&B cost control and inventory reports, highlighting significant variances, trends, and areas requiring management attention. Monitor physical stock counts and reconcile inventory balances between physical stock and system records. Investigate inventory variances, abnormal stock movements, negative stock, wastage, breakages, transfers, and inventory adjustments. Monitor purchasing and receiving activities, including Purchase Orders, Delivery Notes, GRNs, invoice matching, and outstanding transactions. Review supplier pricing and quotation comparisons, highlighting significant price changes or purchasing discrepancies. Maintain and monitor recipe costing to ensure accurate reflection of products, UOMs, quantities, and costs. Support menu pricing and profitability reviews by verifying recipe accuracy, proposed selling prices, and profit margins. Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or incorrectly created products and coordinate with Procurement and Operations for corrective action. Monitor stock holding, stock turnover, slow-moving items, and potential obsolete inventory. Ensure compliance with Cost Control Operating Manuals, procedures, and internal control requirements. Conduct periodic process reviews and follow up with operational teams on identified control gaps and corrective actions. Provide practical cost control guidance to operational teams and support continuous improvement of F&B cost control processes. Assist with the implementation of new cost control processes, Operating Manuals, and training initiatives. Ensure all cost control activities, reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation are completed accurately and within required timelines. Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, strengthen internal controls, reduce unnecessary costs, and improve overall F&B profitability. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi nationality is preferred, subject to applicable Saudization requirements. Must hold a valid SOCPA membership or professional registration, where required by the applicable Saudi professional classification. Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of working experience in a similar position. Experience in receiving, store management, and hotel operations is an advantage. Required Skills Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Good knowledge and hands-on experience using Check SCM is mandatory, including F&B POS systems. High level of attention to detail. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with others to promote a strong teamwork environment. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic global organization focused on enhancing the travel experience.

855aab64880a7978.description: مطلوب مسؤول تطوير أعمال وتسويق هندسي – الرياض شركة هندسية واستشارية في الرياض تعلن عن حاجتها إلى مسؤول تطوير أعمال وتسويق هندسي للانضمام إلى فريقها. نبذة عن الشركة تقدم الشركة مجموعة من الخدمات الهندسية، تشمل: * الاستشارات الهندسية. * التصميم المعماري والإنشائي. * الإشراف الهندسي. * إدارة المشاريع. * ⁠إصدار الرخص بجميع أنواعها * ⁠التصميم الداخلي والخارجي * ⁠إعداد التقارير الفنية * ⁠جميع الخدمات الهندسية الأخرى المهام والمسؤوليات * استقطاب مشاريع وعقود هندسية جديدة. * بناء علاقات مهنية مع المطورين العقاريين وشركات المقاولات والمستثمرين. * التواصل مع أصحاب المشاريع ومديري المشاريع والمشتريات. * البحث عن فرص المشاريع والمناقصات المناسبة. * ترتيب الاجتماعات والزيارات الميدانية للعملاء المحتملين. * متابعة عروض الأسعار والعروض الفنية حتى توقيع العقود. * إعداد قاعدة بيانات للعملاء والفرص التجارية. * تقديم تقارير دورية عن الزيارات والفرص والعقود. المتطلبات * خبرة سابقة في تسويق الخدمات الهندسية أو تطوير الأعمال. * معرفة جيدة بسوق المشاريع العقارية والإنشائية في الرياض. * مهارات عالية في التواصل والتفاوض وإقناع العملاء. * القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية طويلة الأمد. * الاستعداد للعمل الميداني وزيارة العملاء. * يفضل وجود خبرة سابقة في مكتب هندسي أو شركة مقاولات. المميزات * راتب أساسي من 3,000 إلى 5,000 ريال شهريًا، حسب الخبرة. * عمولات مجزية على المشاريع والعقود المحصلة. * فرصة للنمو الوظيفي مع توسع الشركة. للتقديم: يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع توضيح الخبرات السابقة في جلب المشاريع الهندسية، وقيمة أو نوع المشاريع التي سبق للمرشح تسويقها.

85cb07c53bd64ddc.description: About the Role Aramex is seeking a DG HSE Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the safe handling, storage, and transportation of dangerous goods within warehouse and logistics operations. The supervisor will ensure compliance with local and international HSE regulations, company policies, and dangerous goods standards, while promoting a strong safety culture across all warehouse activities. Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with all dangerous goods regulations and standards applicable to warehouse and logistics operations. Monitor storage, segregation, labeling, and documentation requirements for hazardous materials. Conduct regular inspections of dangerous goods storage areas and verify proper packaging, marking, and handling procedures. Review Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS/SDS) and support chemical safety compliance. Implement and monitor HSE policies, procedures, and programs. Conduct workplace risk assessments and hazard identification. Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, recommending corrective actions. Ensure emergency response plans are in place and regularly tested. Monitor daily warehouse operations to ensure safe working practices and conduct routine safety inspections of equipment and facilities. Ensure compliance with Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements and supervise safe loading, unloading, and material handling activities. Deliver Dangerous Goods (DG) and HSE training to warehouse employees and contractors, conducting toolbox talks and safety awareness sessions. Maintain training records and competency assessments. Prepare HSE and DG compliance reports, support internal and external audits, and track corrective actions to ensure closure. Maintain regulatory records and documentation. Coordinate with warehouse operations, transport providers, and regulatory authorities. Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions and assist management in continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 3–5 years of HSE experience in Oil and Gas warehouse/logistics operations. Demonstrated experience in handling dangerous goods compliance. Knowledge of warehouse safety systems and emergency response protocols.

This full-time role involves managing a team of technicians and jewelers in daily operations, providing support to team members while actively participating in technical tasks. The position requires an experienced practitioner with a focus on technical expertise and team support. 8524cb639f6f2b9f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دلتا للتسويق عن مدرب لياقة بدنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على وضع خطط التدريب، توفير الموارد اللازمة، وإجراء تدريبات اللياقة البدنية مع تقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية واستراتيجيات التدريب، مع تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية والقيم المستهدفة ومؤشراتها وقياسها ومتابعتها بانتظام. تحديد وتوفير جميع الموارد والمواد والتقنيات الضرورية للتدريب على اللياقة البدنية، وضمان استخدامها الأمثل. إجراء تدريبات اللياقة البدنية بما يتوافق مع الخطط والأهداف الموضوعة، وتنمية السمات والقدرات التربوية والنفسية الإيجابية لدى المتدربين بشكل متكامل ومتوازن. قياس وتقييم التقدم المحرز في مجال اللياقة البدنية، وتطوير برامج التدريب بناءً على النتائج المحققة. تقديم الدعم والمساندة اللازمة للمتدربين لتمكينهم من رفع قدراتهم وتحقيق أهدافهم، ونقل المعلومات والمعارف إليهم، والإجابة على استفساراتهم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تدريب اللياقة البدنية. القدرة على وضع خطط تدريبية فعالة وتقييم الأداء. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم والإرشاد للمتدربين. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

85f34bde0d73da14.description: About the Role Wood is seeking a PE IV/ PMC Senior Project Engineer to join its Project Management team. This full-time role is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and involves contributing to project development at a remote site in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the Project Execution Plan, Discipline Design Instruction, and Contract requisitions. Prepare project plans and multi-discipline documents, including basis of design and subcontract scopes of work. Manage and coordinate engineering multidiscipline inputs and deliverables across multiple execution centers, including workshare and high-value engineering centers. Understand and adhere to the quality system, monitoring and addressing deficiencies. Ensure Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (HSES) issues are identified and addressed throughout design, manufacture, construction, commissioning, and operations. Develop Project Specific Procedures. Assure the quality of engineering deliverables before issuance to the customer. Chair technical meetings with Third Parties and manage specific technical issues to completion. Schedule Management and Change Control Plan individual work activities and manage time effectively, liaising with disciplines to ensure timely receipt of comments. Provide input to the work plan, set targets, and conduct regular reviews. Expedite Engineers to deliver according to schedule, understand reasons for delays, and drive the development of recovery plans. Resolve most delays or changes, escalating only the most serious issues. Highlight and quantify changes that impact work and implement approved changes. Team Leadership and Coordination Supervise the work of technical professionals in the delivery of engineering deliverables, including checking work. Coordinate medium-sized interdisciplinary teams, typically comprising 10-50 individuals. Communicate effectively to facilitate work effort, motivate the team, and maintain a proactive approach to solutions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to manage and coordinate complex engineering projects. Strong understanding of quality systems and HSES regulations. Proven experience in schedule management and change control processes. Effective leadership and communication skills for team coordination. About Wood Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering, and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in approximately 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara, a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies.

85c1860c0348ffc9.job_title: Senior Manager | Audit | Audit & Assurance | Insurance | Riyadh
85c1860c0348ffc9.description: Job description Position Summary Location: Riyadh Audit & Assurance | Senior Manager About Deloitte : When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award. Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact: Lead the way Serve with integrity Take care of each other Foster inclusion Collaborate for measurable impact Audit & Assurance | Senior Manager During your tenure as a Senior Manager in Audit & Assurance, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas: Identifies the entity's strategic audit and risk priorities and highlights these to key stakeholders, proactively offering strategic insights to address these Makes sure that risk assessment procedures were appropriately considered in the development of the plan, execution of audit procedures, and evaluation of audit results Contributes knowledge and perspective to the risks, materiality and scope discussions for the audit report and checks the audit plan covers all the relevant areas with consideration of wider business issues. Resolves issues identified, including where work has been referred to challenging environments Is familiar with analysis on audit reports, uses the Guide to audit reporting, has read several other audit reports in the same industry before drafting a new report Drives the audit team in a robust approach to revenue testing by: utilizing process flow diagrams for material revenue streams, gaining a deep understanding of the entity's recognition policies and how they relate to terms and conditions, actively considering the appropriateness of a controls reliance approach, and developing a tailored approach to address the risk of fraud Develops and reviews comprehensive project plans for complex engagements early in the audit cycle, that include clear timescales, co-ordination with the extended engagement team, has a clear contingency plan to mitigate the risks of unseen obstructions, and has adequate resources with the required skills and knowledge for testing Communicates the project plan and any entity related dependencies (e.g., documentation, reviews) with the entity's management team so that they are aware, at the beginning of the audit, of any repercussions (e.g., deadlines, fees) due to deviations from this plan. 8541a03d8a14f48d.description: We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help design, scale, and secure our rapidly growing platform infrastructure. You will work across all critical systems — from customer-facing applications and APIs to internal platforms and data services — ensuring availability, performance, and cost efficiency at scale. You’ll be hands-on with Kubernetes, observability, GitOps, automation, and cloud infrastructure, while partnering closely with application, platform, and data teams to deliver a highly reliable and self-healing environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives on complex distributed systems, loves to automate everything, and can balance speed, stability, and cost-efficiency in production. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent work experience . Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain production workloads across Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) clusters. Build self-healing, auto-scaling systems that minimize manual intervention and ensure uptime. Design and operate reliable database and storage platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and object stores) within Kubernetes environments. Implement backup, disaster recovery, replication, and failover strategies to meet RPO/RTO targets. Troubleshoot and recover Kubernetes Persistent Volumes (StorageClasses, CSI drivers, PVC issues) . Optimize storage performance and cost through multi-tier strategies, hot/cold data separation , and S3/offloading lifecycle policies . Secure and scale object storage platforms (e.g., MinIO/S3-compatible) for high-throughput data pipelines . Manage block storage (EBS/io2/gp3) and shared file systems (EFS, NFS) for resilience and cost balance. Collaborate with teams to optimize networking, ingress/egress traffic , and service mesh for secure communication. Platform & Infrastructure Reliability Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain production workloads across Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) clusters. Build self-healing, auto-scaling systems that minimize toil and manual intervention. Optimize networking, ingress/egress traffic control, and service mesh for secure & performant communication. Design and operate reliable database and storage platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and object stores) in Kubernetes environments. Strong knowledge of colour science, colour grading workflows, and LUT management. Competence in audio mixing and sound design. Knowledge of video/audio formats, codecs, and multi-platform delivery specifications. Familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems and metadata standards.
